rows.stock_6_12: yes: fscrypt v2 + IV_INO_LBLK_64 + blk-crypto (inline engine or blk-crypto-fallback)

rows.value: EFS ext4 -> /mnt/vendor/efs (errors=panic, wait,check); bind to /efs; CPEFS ext4 ro,noload,nofail -> /mnt/vendor/cpefs

rows.value: libion_exynos getDefaultExporter(): open("/dev/dma_heap/system") ok -> mode 3 (dma-heap); else open /dev/ion + ION_IOC_FREE(handle 0): errno ENOTTY -> mode 1 (modern ION), other -> mode 2 (legacy ION)
rows.port_6_12: ACFG: DMABUF_HEAPS=y DMABUF_HEAPS_SYSTEM=y DMABUF_HEAPS_CMA=y -> the android-config kernel already makes libion_exynos take the dma-heap path; G also carries legacy ION

rows.value: /dev/dma_heap/<name>[-secure|-uncached]: heap-id bit -> name: 0 system, 1 crypto, 2 reserved(vfw), 3 system-secure-vstream, 4 reserved, 5 vframe, 6 vscaler, 7 reserved(vnfw), 8 gpu_crc, 9 system-secure-gpu_buffer, 10 camera, 11 secure_camera, 12 reserved, 13 ext_ui, 14 system(vendor_system_heap).
